release.content: pubkit 0.14.5 was released on 2026-10-28 from commit 02197aa196ae25c75366da88d4a3787ecf90c457 with these changes.

rows: Every sonar job (rust-ci.yml, python-ci.yml, node-ci.yml and the generated CI's job-sonar.yml) waits for SonarQube Cloud's quality gate, with -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true and a 300-second timeout, so a failing gate fails the job and `ci / passed` with it; before, the job only uploaded the analysis and passed whatever the gate said (on publet#56, `ci / passed` was green while the gate failed)
